ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: RSTV is a trapezoid with bases $\overline{RV}$ and $\overline{ST}$ and median $\overline{MN}$. Find $x$ if $MN=60$, $ST=4x-1$, and $RV=6x+11$.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The image shows quadrilateral RSTV is a trapezoid, the upper RV and the lower ST are two parallel bases, MN is the midline/median connecting the two legs, and is parallel to the two bases. According to the trapezoid midline theorem, the length of the median equals the average of the lengths of the two bases, so MN = (ST + RV) / 2. Substitute MN = 60, ST = 4x - 1, RV = 6x + 11, to get 60 = ((4x - 1) + (6x + 11)) / 2. Simplify: 60 = (10x + 10) / 2, so 120 = 10x + 10, 110 = 10x, x = 11.
